Yashyaa Biryani Recipe's

Yashya Special Chicken Biryani!!!!!

The ultimate aromatic experience with tender chicken and saffron-infused rice.

Ingredients (Serves 4)

Rice
  • 300g basmati rice (cooked and cooled)
To marinate the chicken:
  • 600g boneless chicken thighs (bite-size pieces)
  • 3 tbsp Greek yoghurt
  • 1/2 tsp turmeric powder
  • 1/4 tsp mild chilli powder
  • Salt to taste
To cook the chicken:
  • 3 tbsp vegetable oil or ghee
  • 4 green cardamom pods
  • 1 tsp cumin seeds
  • 200g white onion (thinly sliced)
  • 160g chopped tomatoes
  • 1 tbsp tomato puree
  • 2 green chillies (slit)
  • 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste
  • 1 tsp coriander powder
To garnish:
  • Saffron soaked in warm milk
  • 1/2 tsp garam masala
  • 2 tbsp chopped mint leaves
  • 2 tbsp chopped coriander leaves

Method

  1. Marinate: Combine chicken with yoghurt, turmeric, chilli powder, and salt. Rest for 20 minutes or overnight.
  2. Sauté: Heat oil in a pan. Add cardamom and cumin. Add onions and fry 10–12 min until golden. Add tomatoes and cook for 3 min.
  3. Simmer: Add tomato puree, chillies, ginger-garlic paste, and coriander powder. Add marinated chicken and cook 3–4 min. Add a splash of water if needed and simmer 5 minutes.
  4. Layer: Layer half the rice over the chicken base. Add saffron milk, garam masala, mint, and coriander. Repeat layers.
  5. Dum: Cover tightly and cook on low flame for 5 minutes. Let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
